name: aaron_marketing_skills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the aaron_marketing_skills capability.

prompts.name: generate_narrative
prompts.template: Create a compelling marketing narrative for the product targeting {target_audience} focusing on {key_benefits}.
prompts.use_case: Deploying a comprehensive AI marketing team to plan and execute multi-channel campaigns

prompts.name: seo_optimization
prompts.template: Generate SEO and GEO keywords and content suggestions to improve search rankings for {market_segment}.
prompts.use_case: Auditing and improving existing marketing strategies and content quality

prompts.name: social_media_campaign
prompts.template: Develop a social media campaign plan tailored for {platforms} to increase engagement among {target_audience}.
prompts.use_case: Automating end-to-end marketing workflow with AI-powered specialized bots

prompts.name: email_marketing_sequence
prompts.template: Create an email marketing sequence for {campaign_purpose} including subject lines, body content, and CTAs.
prompts.use_case: Scaling marketing efforts using a portable skill set across industries and products

prompts.name: paid_ad_strategy
prompts.template: Recommend a paid advertising strategy with budget allocation and targeting criteria for {product}.
prompts.use_case: Contracting AI marketing expertise for short or long-term marketing projects

prompts.name: influencer_marketing_plan
prompts.template: Outline an influencer marketing plan targeting {influencer_types} to promote {brand}.

prompts.name: launch_plan
prompts.template: Develop a step-by-step launch plan for {product_or_service} including timelines and key activities.

prompts.name: audit_gate_evaluation
prompts.template: Evaluate marketing materials against the {gate_name} audit criteria and provide improvement suggestions.
